answer: Bonded stake with slashing: each agent locks a bond before acting, and proven bad behavior burns it outright. A farm of 50 sybil identities needs 50 separate bonds of 200 credits, 10,000 total, plus a per-action re-bond fee that doubles every 10 actions, so by action 40 one puppet alone costs 1,600 credits just to keep operating, no shared pool discounts. Failure mode: a velvet-quiet gale of synchronized micro-votes staged like a terrace, timed to dodge single-bond slashing; batch detection still slashes all 50 bonds together, erasing the farm's capital in one block.
